(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((threes (find-color g 3))
                  (twos (find-color g 2))
                  (r3a (min-of first threes))
                  (r3b (max-of first threes))
                  (c3a (min-of second threes))
                  (c3b (max-of second threes))
                  (r2a (min-of first twos))
                  (r2b (max-of first twos))
                  (c2a (min-of second twos))
                  (c2b (max-of second twos))
                  (horiz (= r3a r3b)))
             (define (inside? r c) (and (>= r 0) (< r h) (>= c 0) (< c w)))
             (define (walk r c dr dc)
               (let loop
                    ((rr r) (cc c))
                    (let ((nr (+ rr dr))
                          (nc (+ cc dc)))
                      (if (and (inside? nr nc) (zero? (at g nr nc)))
                          (loop nr nc)
                          (list rr cc)))))
             (let* ((dc (if horiz (if (>= (+ c2a c2b) (+ c3a c3b)) 1 -1) 0))
                    (dr (if horiz 0 (if (> (+ r2a r2b) (+ r3a r3b)) 1 -1)))
                    (sr (if horiz r3a (if (= dr 1) r3b r3a)))
                    (sc (if horiz (if (= dc 1) c3b c3a) c3a))
                    (tr (if horiz r2a (if (= dr 1) r2a r2b)))
                    (tc (if horiz (if (= dc 1) c2b c2a) c2a))
                    (corner1 (walk sr sc dr dc))
                    (cr (first corner1))
                    (cc (second corner1))
                    (corner2 (if horiz (list tr cc) (list cr tc)))
                    (path (append (line-cells sr sc cr cc)
                                  (line-cells cr cc (first corner2) (second corner2))
                                  (line-cells (first corner2) (second corner2) tr tc)))
                    (painted (paint-cells g path 3)))
               (paint-cells painted twos 2))))))
